was wondering whats a good team
so i returned to morimens after quitting for a while. i need help building a team, and who to pull for. i wanted to try pulling for caraboo but should i save?
okay i also have a gambling addiction so i just got e0 caraboo & vortice

Hello there and welcome back <:Saya_foto:1513124059334971402> 

I'd say Caraboo is fun to play, if hard to master.
She doesn't deplete your health directly ( just can self-inflict poison if you're unlucky ) so she makes a pretty decent support for caro.

Your roster is quite exhaustive so building a team can go several ways.

Do you have 1 or 2 fetish awakeners ?

Hello there and welcome aboard <:Saya_wow:1513124172895879198> 

Thanks for reading the handbook ! It really helps helping you <:Saya_snack:1513123743986094161> 

1. Helot is pretty meta with Mouchette.
But in the end it *is* a game and I suggest you play whatever feels more interesting to you. Especially in the early chapter.

2. The cradle banner is a great option and yes, Thaïs is highly recommanded. Not just with Mouchette but in any team because she can both debuff ennemies and give allies tons of aliemus and skill copies.

That written, weither you pull for her of not is your own choice in the end. Did you try to borrow her from someone else in the events ?

3. Both. You will eventually want 5 teams ( 19 awakeners ) for D-tide so getting a bit of everything early is a way to get used to different playstyles.
Æquor are generally more newcommer-friendly but caro have lots of heal.
Ultra are harder to manage but quite interesting once you get used to them
